title: Harness staging edits are a supported path and publish without conflict

input.ownership: this backend owns the project; the harness writes only under .thirdlight/staging/

stage.edit: file replaced while the backend owns the project, before the publish command

steps.action: the next mutation runs the §5.2 pre-write check

durableEffects: the staged bytes are copied to sources/sha256/<digest> and referenced by the catalog; the staged file itself stays non-authoritative
observations: §5.2 and §7 are scoped to scenes/main.json; no supported path may extend them to .thirdlight/**
the staged bytes are treated as untrusted input: traversal/symlink checks, size caps and the full import profile apply
the digest is recomputed from the bytes on disk at publish time; a caller-supplied digest is never trusted

notes: BR-4 (docs/handoffs/m2-plan-review.md): the failure this prevents is §7 treating a harness staging write as an unexpected external modification, pausing writes and quarantining the staged bytes.
